disclosure: This export contains selected real project prompts and conservative summaries of the project workflow. It does not invent AI responses or tool executions.

sessions.summary: Phase 5: campaign frontend and submission form
sessions.prompt:
I explicitly approve beginning **Phase 5 - Campaign Frontend and Submission Form**.

Follow the approved PROMPT.md and all Phase 1-4 architecture decisions.

Scope:
1. Build the Kadak Chai Co. #MyChaiBreak campaign landing page using Next.js App Router, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
2. Create a polished, responsive design.
3. Implement Full name, City, Email/Indian mobile, Story (10-300 characters), and mandatory consent.
4. Add character count and loading, success, validation, pending-review, and error states.
5. Connect to POST /api/entries and prevent accidental duplicate submissions.
6. Never expose private data or technical AI/provider errors.
7. Keep the page accessible and responsive.

Strict boundaries: do not implement public result pages or admin features, and do not begin Phase 6 or later.
sessions.notable_result: Campaign UI and submission states were implemented and Phase 5 documentation was created.

sessions.prompt:
I explicitly approve beginning **Phase 7 - Admin Authentication and Dashboard**.

Implement environment-configured admin login using the approved HMAC-SHA256 signed session architecture. Protect dashboard and APIs server-side. Build filterable/paginated submission metrics and details. Allow approve/reject moderation with optional notes while preserving original AI fields. Add authorization and audit tests.
sessions.notable_result: Admin login, signed cookie sessions, protected dashboard/API routes, and audited overrides were implemented.

sessions.prompt:
I explicitly approve beginning **Phase 8 - Automated Testing and QA**.

Review missing coverage across submission validation, persistence, AI, public privacy/access, admin authorization, and dashboard behavior. Add mandatory malformed AI parser tests, security/privacy checks, dependency audits, and genuine defect fixes. Run the complete suite and production build. Do not begin deployment or optional improvements.
sessions.notable_result: QA coverage expanded to 83 tests; timeout, public 404, Vitest hooks, and other defects were corrected or documented.
